## magnet resolve request

Given a magnet resolves the files and computes the chunks, it's already working, use this only for the demo

```js
fetch("https://bstream.ssimo.dev/resolve", {
  "headers": {
    "accept": "*/*",
    "accept-language": "en-US,en;q=0.7",
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "sec-ch-ua": "\"Not=A?Brand\";v=\"99\", \"Brave\";v=\"151\", \"Chromium\";v=\"151\"",
    "sec-ch-ua-mobile": "?0",
    "sec-ch-ua-platform": "\"Linux\"",
    "sec-fetch-dest": "empty",
    "sec-fetch-mode": "cors",
    "sec-fetch-site": "cross-site",
    "sec-gpc": "1",
    "Referer": "https://wincisky.github.io/"
  },
  "body": "{\"magnet\":\"magnet:?xt=urn:btih:dd8255ecdc7ca55fb0bbf81323d87062db1f6d1c&dn=Big+Buck+Bunny&tr=udp%3A%2F%2Ftracker.opentrackr.org%3A1337&tr=udp%3A%2F%2Fexplodie.org%3A6969\",\"force\":false}",
  "method": "POST"
});
```

## file chunks request

Once the magnet resolve request has been called the chunks and peers list can be recovered from the following production url, passing the id of the magnet (the input you have)

This endpoint can also be called once all the peers have been exhausted and new ones are needed adding the `?refresh=1` parameter.

`https://bstream.ssimo.dev/records/dd8255ecdc7ca55fb0bbf81323d87062db1f6d1c`
